## Activity

During February 2020, Central Eye Clinic recorded 145 captures. This report summarises activity for the month and presents the associated image-quality and grading outcomes. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing the proportion of images that could not be assessed and the number of results identified as referable.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 3 were recorded as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.1. This indicates that the available images were suitable for grading in the large majority of cases, while a small proportion could not be assessed. The ungradable count and rate should be considered alongside the total capture activity when monitoring site performance over time.

## Grading

There were 30 referable results during February 2020. The median lag for grading was 1. This records the midpoint of the time taken for grading and provides an overall measure of timeliness for the month. Together, the referable result count and median lag describe both the clinical output and the speed of the grading process at Central Eye Clinic.
